title: 128x128 MCU uniqueness criterion
proof: Within 128..255, ceil(d/16)=8 only for d=128. Therefore a verified total of exactly 64 MCUs uniquely forces width=height=128.
historical_connection: December-2025 community forensics reported almost 64 repeated bit-pattern groups and independently speculated near-128x128 geometry.
conclusion: The old 'almost 64' observation now has a precise target: if those groups can be shown to be one-per-MCU and the count is exactly 64, 128x128 follows uniquely. 'Almost 64' by itself is not enough.
